Went with the berry flavored tobaccos today

The Cult - Blood Red Moon is probably the best cherry flavored pipe tobacco I’ve come across. It’s fire-cured Cavendish, bright Virginias, and Burleys that’s flavored with Royal Ann cherry and dark chocolate. The black Cavendish seems to make up most of the blend but it taste like cherrys and chocolate all the way thru the bowl till it ashed out. The Devil’s Holiday is made by Dan Tobacco of Germany. It’s Black Cavendish and Virginia’s, flavored with wild forest berries. The Cavendish and Virginia seems to be blended half and half so it has that stronger Virginia taste than most flavored Aeros. The tobacco smells so damn good when I opened the tin, I wanted to pour some milk on it and eat it. The berry smell reminds me of Big League chewing gum and the berry taste last all the way through the bowl. It will ghost your pipe if you smoke too much. This is a good flavored tobacco for someone who doesn’t like the mildness of straight Cavendish.

The forest berry one sounds really interesting, I'm sure the cherry is great too but I've had tonnes of cherry tobacco's a wild berry sounds really nice. Sounds like something good for a meerschaum since they are pretty much unghostable. You'd have to smoke the same tobacco for many years to ghost a meerschaum.

Dan Tobaccos Devil's Holiday is one hell of a blend. When you open the tin its like getting run over by a freight truck full of berries. The best thing about it is it taste exactly like it smells which seems to be rare for a flavored aromatic and the Virginia's give it a stronger character than most flavored Aros. I haven't found too many aromatics that actually taste like they are flavored. The berry taste in this blend is overwhelming and it last all the way through the bowl. If you can get your hands on a tin it's definitely worth trying out. It's from Germany so you might be able to get it in Canada. Dan Tobacco makes a lot of good blends.Here's another one I smoke sometimes by Dan. https://www.smokingpipes.com/pipe-tobacco/dan-tobacco/Blue-Note-250g/product_id/9002 Sutliff makes a blue note also and it's not the same.
